title: Spatial Visualization
question_text: Start with these two pieces. Add the third, then take away the first. What remains?
explanation_script: Start with these two pieces. Add the third, then take away the first. What remains?
Start with two pieces. Add a third. Take the first one away.
Here are the five answer choices, A through E.
The correct answer is C.
The added piece stays, the removed piece disappears.
So the answer is C.
